description: The journalists were allowed back in the White House six days after being banned by President Trump. District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that revoking the media outlets' press credentials 'likely violated their constitutional due process rights.'

headline: AI and literature: 'No one in this debate has asked whether a writer has the right to work with a machine'
description: Writer Sébastien Bailly regrets that authors are only allowed two stances regarding artificial intelligence: that of the innocent or that of the cheat. Writers should be able to use this tool transparently, he argues for Le Monde.

description: The pope's trip to France aims to celebrate Catholicism's renewed dynamism in the country, where baptisms among teenagers and adults have risen sharply. This phenomenon has gone hand in hand with a strengthening of conservative forces.

description: Speaking at the UN on Wednesday, the Ukrainian president ruled out, as did Moscow, any moratorium on attacks targeting energy infrastructure. Aware that 'winter could be very harsh,' he nonetheless called for de-escalation measures.
